user.title: MowMaster - Initial Setup
user.description: Configure your robotic lawn mower and weather provider. MowMaster calculates optimal mowing windows and biological grass growth automatically.

data.lawn_irrigated: Lawn is regularly irrigated in summer

data_description.mower_entity: Select your robotic lawn mower entity (e.g. lawn_mower.bobbi).
data_description.weather_entity: Weather integration providing temperature, humidity, and rain forecasts.
data_description.lawn_area: Total lawn area to mow in square meters.
data_description.mower_type: Select the navigation principle of your mower.
data_description.lawn_irrigated: Enable if the lawn is irrigated during dry summer periods (prevents heat-slump growth reduction).
data_description.configure_pro: Enable to immediately configure local sensors (weather station, dew point, soil moisture) and custom thresholds.

pro_sensors.title: Step 2: Local Sensors & Moisture Sources
pro_sensors.description: Override standard weather entity data with high-precision local weather station, soil moisture sensors, or existing lawn wetness scores.

data.sensor_dew_point: Dew Point Sensor (e.g. DWD or Weather Station)
data.sensor_rain_radar: Rain Radar Sensor (e.g. DWD Next Rain)
data.sensor_solar_diff: Solar Differencing Temperature Sensor (e.g. Homematic Ch3)
data.sensor_battery: Separate Battery Sensor (if not in mower)

data_description.sensor_temp: Local high-precision outdoor temperature for GDD growth and frost protection.
data_description.sensor_humidity: Local relative humidity for dew point calculations.
data_description.sensor_dew_point: Direct dew point sensor for high accuracy dew tracking.
data_description.sensor_moisture_score: Optional existing moisture score entity (0-100 pts).
data_description.sensor_mower_rain: Hardware rain sensor on the mower body for instant abort.
data_description.sensor_rain: Local rain gauge for precipitation tracking in mm.
data_description.sensor_rain_radar: Next rain arrival forecast sensor for anticipatory docking.
data_description.sensor_solar_diff: Sun vs shade differential temperature sensor for rapid surface drying detection.
data_description.sensor_wind: Wind speed sensor for evapotranspiration modeling.
data_description.sensor_soil: Soil moisture sensor to track irrigation and drought conditions.
data_description.sensor_battery: Battery level entity if not integrated in the mower entity.

pro_thresholds.title: Step 3: Thresholds & Protection Rules
pro_thresholds.description: Fine-tune environmental conditions for lawn health, minimum temperature, and wildlife protection.

data.dew_spread_min: Min. Dew Spread (°C for dry grass)
data.min_temp: Minimum Mowing Temperature (°C, turf frost protection)
data.heat_limit: Heat Protection Limit (°C, prevents lawn burn)
data.moisture_threshold: Wetness Score Threshold (pts, below is dry)
data.radar_rain_buffer: Rain Radar Lead Time (minutes to rain)

data_description.dew_spread_min: Difference between ambient temperature and dew point. Above 2.5°C to 3.0°C grass is dry of dew.
data_description.min_temp: Below this temperature mowing is prohibited to prevent cold-stress damage to grass blades.
data_description.heat_limit: Above this temperature mowing is paused to protect fragile heat-stressed turf.
data_description.moisture_threshold: Threshold under which the lawn is considered dry enough to mow (default 3.0 pts).
data_description.radar_rain_buffer: Lead time in minutes before rain starts to send the mower back home safely.
data_description.wildlife_enabled: Protects hedgehogs and nocturnal animals by keeping the mower docked from dusk till dawn.
data_description.wildlife_sunrise_offset: Minutes to wait after sunrise before mowing can begin.
data_description.wildlife_sunset_offset: Minutes before sunset by which the mower must return to the dock.
data_description.quiet_hours_start: Start time of nighttime noise restriction (e.g. 20:00).
data_description.quiet_hours_end: End time of nighttime noise restriction (e.g. 08:00).

pro_mower.title: Step 4: Mowing Runtime, Battery & Edge Cutting
pro_mower.description: Mowing capacity, multi-cycle scheduling, and brand-specific edge trimming.

data.max_run_time: Max Runtime per Session (minutes, 0 = until battery low)
data.edge_cut_interval: Edge Trim Interval (every N runs, 0 = off)

data_description.mower_capacity: Net area coverage in m²/h (~50 m²/h for random bounce, ~120 m²/h for RTK/systematic).
data_description.min_battery_level: Minimum battery charge before MowMaster issues a start command.
data_description.max_run_time: Maximum runtime in minutes for a single run (0 = run until mower returns by battery level).
data_description.multi_cycle: Allows the mower to make additional runs after recharging if daily target budget is not yet met.
data_description.edge_cut_interval: Triggers edge trimming every N runs (e.g. 3 = every 3rd run).
data_description.edge_cut_service: Optional Home Assistant service call for brand-specific boundary/edge cut.
data_description.edge_cut_data: Optional JSON parameters passed to the edge cut service call.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to lawn mower.

abort.already_configured: This lawn mower is already configured in MowMaster.
